name: Kanto in Motion
description: Kanto in Motion v1.4.0 Gen 1 HD battle overhaul. Adds HD animated Pokemon #001-151, 1920x950 location-aware time-of-day battle backgrounds, integrated Gen 1 move animations, Modern battle UI, shiny encounter effects, and PC/mobile compatibility for Battle Art and PotatoVoxel. Gen 2 support is not included in this release.
